title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:la-versus-meus
canDo: I can write one line of Latin about myself from a closed supply of known words and forms, choosing not only which word but which ending it wears.

payoff.summary: Complete LA-W02-versus-meus: one line chosen rather than copied, using only forms the book has shown rather than forms guessed from a pattern.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for, and harder in Latin than in the Latin-script tracks: the job of a word comes from its ending, so choosing the word is only half the choice.
